name: enterprise-collaboration-analytics-platform
description: Enterprise Collaboration & Analytics Platform for SMEs - graduation project monorepo

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w packages/common-dto -w packages/common-guard -w packages/common-metrics
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspaces --if-present -w apps/gateway -w apps/iam-service -w apps/project-task-service -w apps/document-service -w apps/notification-service -w apps/analytics-service -w apps/crm-service -w apps/hrm-service -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && tsc --noEmit -p apps/gateway/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/iam-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/project-task-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/document-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/notification-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/analytics-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/crm-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/hrm-service/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
